user_query: My company is building an email validation service. I would like to incorporate multiple API functions to ensure accurate results. Can you guide me on how to use the API functions to verify email existence, check for disposable emails, and retrieve MX records?

TaskList.description: Verify the existence of an email address by calling an API that checks if the email is valid and currently in use.
Check if the email is disposable by calling an API that identifies temporary email providers.
Retrieve MX records for the provided email domain by calling an API that fetches DNS information.
